final_assessment: Q-crc-15 measured and its document half repaired. Running both fence grammars over all 308 tracked markdown files turned an unsized concern into an actionable one: they disagree on 5 files and 382 of 52,805 lines, concentrated in two documents. The reframing that matters is that the heuristic is wrong in BOTH directions — it rescued a malformed baseline spec whose 24 requirement and scenario declarations sat inside an unclosed fence (rendering as one grey code block on GitHub), and it mis-parses a correctly authored document, letting seven lines of an ASCII diagram escape a four-backtick fence. The malformed spec is fixed and the fix verified inert to the engine: the shipped parser sees the same 9 requirements before and after. docs/concepts.md needed no change. The remaining work is sized as an ordinary small change rather than a stage, and the three files that still disagree are archived records that are correctly left alone. Recorded convention exception: the baseline spec was edited directly rather than through a change delta, because the edit alters two fence characters, changes no requirement text and no parse, and no active change fingerprints that capability.
